scope: A2 co-periodic linear temporal spectral instability only

profile_seed.identity_boundary: A2 is a numerical family/relative-winding label, not yet a certified V6 cell or V7 edge word

periodic_profile_enclosure_target.central_initial_state: (s,0,V0(s),0), with V0(s) fixed by the zero-energy equation
periodic_profile_enclosure_target.phase_condition: x=0 lies in Fix(R): P(0)=Q(0)=0; s is restricted to the declared non-equilibrium box
periodic_profile_enclosure_target.required_method: outward-rounded interval Newton or Krawczyk enclosure of one unique zero in an explicit lifted multiple-shooting subbox contained in the preselection boxes; no uniqueness assertion for the entire preselection box
periodic_profile_enclosure_target.required_identity: target-specific true periodic orbit near the frozen seed; V6/V7 symbolic edge binding is not required for the spectral theorem

variational_instability_target.conclusion_if_validated: one real co-periodic eigenvalue lambda_* in (0.01,2), separated from the translation eigenvalue zero

central_augmented_integral.validation_note: augment the same multiple-shooting orbit; this single scalar gate replaces a rigorous spectral discretization

minimal_claim_bearing_inputs: one true reversible periodic shooting root in the frozen (s,T) box
an outward-rounded enclosure of the augmented physical moments proving the frozen strict upper bound
not_required: algebraic multiplicity of the positive eigenvalue

nonclaims: The saved NPZ arrays are not an enclosure of a true periodic profile.
The floating moment and Fourier calculations are not interval proofs.
The A2 metadata do not certify a V6 return cell or a V7 symbolic edge.
Co-periodic spectral instability is not nonlinear instability or dynamical pattern selection.
